name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a Reno-based mineral exploration and royalty company focused primarily on gold properties in Nevada and Idaho. The company pursues a diversified model combining active property exploration across projects including Loman, Agai-Pah, and Belshazzar with the acquisition of royalty interests on precious metal assets. It is in the exploration stage, building a portfolio of cash-flowing and development-stage mineral assets.
